lessons.title: I'd like some tea, please
lessons.goal_uz: Ovqat va ichimliklarni nomlaysiz, a / an / some ni to'g'ri ishlatasiz va "I'd like..." bilan buyurtma berasiz.

words.ex: I have an egg for breakfast.
I don't eat a lot of meat.

steps.title: Breakfast at a café
steps.context_uz: Aziz va Laylo ertalab kafega kirishdi.

lines.en: Good morning! What would you like?
I'd like two eggs and some bread, please.
lines.uz: Ikkita tuxum va biroz non, iltimos.

lines.en: And to drink?
A cup of tea, please.
I'm not very hungry. I'd like an apple and some orange juice.
lines.uz: Qornim unchalik och emas. Bitta olma va biroz apelsin sharbati olaman.

lines.en: OK. Two eggs, bread, tea, an apple and orange juice.
lines.uz: Xo'p. Ikkita tuxum, non, choy, olma va apelsin sharbati.

steps.body_uz:
Sanaladigan otlar birlikda **a** yoki **an** oladi: **a** banana, **an** apple.
**an** — unli tovush bilan boshlanadigan so'zdan oldin: **an** egg, **an** orange, **an** hour.
Sanalmaydigan otlar (suv, non, guruch, go'sht, choy) **a/an** olmaydi: some water, some bread. ("a bread" — xato!)
Ko'plikda va sanalmaydigan otlarda **some** — "biroz, bir nechta": some apples, some rice.
Buyurtma: **I'd like** (= I would like) + ot — "... olmoqchiman". Bu "I want"dan ancha xushmuomala.

examples.en: There is some rice in the kitchen.
She eats a banana every morning.
examples.uz: U har kuni ertalab bitta banan yeydi.

steps.explain_uz: egg — unli tovush bilan boshlanadi → **an** egg.

steps.text: I'd ___ a cup of coffee, please.

steps.answer: I'd like a cup of tea

steps.say: Hello. I'd like some rice and a glass of water, please.
steps.explain_uz: "some rice and a glass of water".

steps.uz: Men bitta olma va biroz non olmoqchiman.
answer: I'd like an apple and some bread
I would like an apple and some bread

steps.text: I'd like some bread and a cup of tea, please.

steps.prompt_uz: Nonushtada nima yeysiz va ichasiz? 4–5 gap yozing. a / an / some ni ishlating.
steps.prompt: What do you eat and drink for breakfast?
steps.example: For breakfast I usually have some bread and an egg. I drink a cup of green tea. Sometimes I eat an apple or a banana. My father likes some meat in the morning, but I don't.

lessons.title: Can you swim?
lessons.goal_uz: Nima qila olishingiz va qila olmasligingizni aytasiz: I can swim, I can't drive. Can you...? savoliga javob berasiz.

words.ex: My little brother can ride a bike.

steps.title: A new friend at the summer camp
steps.context_uz: Sardor yozgi lagerda yangi do'st Kate bilan tanishdi.

lines.en: Can you swim, Sardor?
Yes, I can. I swim every summer. Can you?
lines.uz: Ha, olaman. Har yozda suzaman. Sen-chi?

lines.en: No, I can't. But I can ride a bike very well.
lines.uz: Yo'q, olmayman. Lekin velosipedni juda yaxshi hayday olaman.

lines.en: Can you speak Russian?
A little. I can speak English and French. And you?
lines.uz: Ozgina. Inglizcha va fransuzcha gapira olaman. Sen-chi?

lines.en: I can speak Uzbek, Russian and a little English.
lines.uz: O'zbekcha, ruscha va ozgina inglizcha gapira olaman.

lines.en: Your English is good!

steps.q: What can Kate do very well?
steps.explain_uz: "I can ride a bike very well."

steps.body_uz:
**can** + fe'lning asosiy shakli — "... qila olaman". Hamma shaxslarda bir xil: I can, he **can**, they can. ("he cans" — xato!)
**can** dan keyin **to** qo'yilmaydi: I can swim. ("I can to swim" — xato!)
Inkor: **can't** (= cannot): I **can't** drive.
Savol: **Can** you cook? — Yes, I **can**. / No, I **can't**.
Talaffuz: gapda **can** qisqa aytiladi /kən/, **can't** esa uzun va urg'uli /kɑːnt/ — farqni eshitishga harakat qiling.

examples.en: My sister can sing very well.
examples.uz: Singlim juda yaxshi qo'shiq ayta oladi.

examples.en: Can your father cook? — Yes, he can.
examples.uz: Otangiz ovqat pishira oladimi? — Ha, oladi.

steps.text: My grandmother ___ make very good plov.
steps.uz: Buvim juda mazali palov qila oladi.
Men mashina hayday olmayman. Atigi o'n ikki yoshdaman!

steps.answer: My brother can't ride a bike

steps.say: I can sing and I can dance, but I can't swim.

steps.uz: Men ovqat pishira olaman, lekin qo'shiq ayta olmayman.
answer: I can cook but I can't sing
I can cook, but I can't sing
I can cook but I cannot sing

steps.text: I can swim and ride a bike, but I can't drive.

steps.prompt_uz: Nima qila olasiz va nima qila olmaysiz? 5 ta gap yozing (can / can't).
steps.prompt: What can you do? What can't you do?
steps.example: I can speak Uzbek and Russian. I can speak a little English too. I can cook eggs, but I can't cook plov. I can ride a bike, but I can't swim. I want to learn to swim this summer.

lessons.title: What are you doing?
lessons.goal_uz: Hozir sodir bo'layotgan ishlarni aytasiz: I'm reading. She's cooking. Present Continuous va Present Simple farqini bilib olasiz.

steps.title: A phone call home
steps.context_uz: Nodira ishdan uyiga qo'ng'iroq qildi. Telefonni o'g'li Javohir oldi.

lines.en: Hi, Javohir! What are you doing?
I'm doing my homework, Mum.
Good boy! Where's your sister?
She's in her room. She's sleeping.
And Dad?
He's watching football on TV. Is it raining there?
lines.uz: Televizorda futbol ko'ryapti. U yerda yomg'ir yog'yaptimi?

lines.en: Yes, it is. I'm waiting for a taxi now. See you soon!
lines.uz: Ha, yog'yapti. Hozir taksi kutyapman. Tez orada ko'rishamiz!

steps.body_uz:
Tuzilma: **am / is / are + fe'l-ing** — "...yapman".
I **am** reading. He/She/It **is** sleeping. We/You/They **are** playing.
Inkor: I'm **not** working. She **isn't** cooking.
Savol: **Are** you listening? — Yes, I am. / **What are** you doing?
Imlo: write → writ**ing** (e tushadi), swim → swi**mm**ing, run → ru**nn**ing.
Farq: **Present Simple** — odat (I drink tea **every day**). **Present Continuous** — hozir (I'm drinking coffee **now**).

examples.en: They aren't watching TV. They're playing.
I usually walk to school, but today I'm taking a taxi.
examples.uz: Odatda maktabga piyoda boraman, lekin bugun taksida ketyapman.

steps.explain_uz: Qisqa unli + undosh → undosh ikkilanadi: swi**mm**ing.

steps.answer: She isn't doing her homework now

steps.say: I'm standing at the bus stop. It's raining and I'm waiting for bus number twelve.

steps.text: Right now I'm sitting at home and I'm learning English.

steps.prompt_uz: Hozir uyingizda (yoki atrofingizda) kim nima qilyapti? 5 ta gap yozing.
steps.prompt: What are the people around you doing right now?
steps.example: Right now I'm sitting in my room and I'm learning English. My mother is cooking dinner in the kitchen. My father isn't at home. He's working. My little sister is watching cartoons. It's raining outside.
